products.name: Karni Premium CTC Chai
products.shortDescription: Bold, granular CTC tea for a full-bodied daily cup.
products.description: Our everyday hero. Premium CTC (crush-tear-curl) granules that brew quickly into a strong, full-bodied chai with a rich colour. Made for kadak doodh-wali chai at home, office or tapri.
brewingTips: Boil water first, add tea and simmer for 1–2 minutes.
Add milk and sugar, bring to a boil twice for a kadak cup.

products.name: Karni Masala Chai
products.shortDescription: CTC tea blended with classic Indian chai spices.
products.description: A warm, aromatic blend of our CTC tea with traditional chai masala spices. Brew it the desi way for a spiced cup that tastes like home.
brewingTips: Use 1 teaspoon per cup – the masala is already blended in.
Simmer with water for 2 minutes to release the spices.
Add milk, boil once more and strain.

products.name: Karni Elaichi Chai
products.shortDescription: Strong CTC tea with the sweet aroma of cardamom.
products.description: Our strong CTC base blended with cardamom (elaichi) for a fragrant, soothing cup. Perfect for guests, morning rituals and evening breaks.
brewingTips: Do not over-boil after adding milk to keep the elaichi aroma fresh.
Let it rest for 30 seconds before straining.

products.name: Karni Strong Dust Tea
products.shortDescription: Fine dust tea for an extra-strong, quick-brewing cup.
products.description: Fine-grade dust tea that releases colour and strength in seconds. Ideal for those who love a very strong, dark chai and for high-volume brewing.
brewingTips: Use a little less – about ¾ teaspoon per cup.
Brews fast: 45–60 seconds of boiling is enough.

products.name: Karni Gold Leaf Tea
products.shortDescription: Long leaf tea for a bright, aromatic and smooth cup.
products.description: Our premium long-leaf selection for those who enjoy a lighter, aromatic cup. Brew it with or without milk and enjoy its bright golden liquor.
brewingTips: Steep in freshly boiled water for 3–4 minutes for black tea.
For milk chai, simmer for 3 minutes before adding milk.

products.name: Karni Family Pack
products.shortDescription: Our everyday CTC blend in value sizes for the whole family.
products.description: The same Karni taste in a value pack for big families, offices and shops. Strong, consistent and easy on the pocket.
brewingTips: Simmer for 2 minutes with water before adding milk.
Store in an airtight container after opening.
